title: Growing on X in 2026: What Works Now That Video Rules the Feed
description: X stopped being a text platform. Here's how growth actually works in 2026, where short video, long posts and replies compete for the same feed and reach.
excerpt: On X, reach isn't bought with ads — it's earned with reply speed. Here's what actually moves follower counts in 2026.
content:
X has changed more in two years than any other network. What was a text platform is now a hybrid where short video, long-form posts and live replies fight for the same feed. If you're still posting links, your reach is close to zero.

## Replies beat your own posts

The X algorithm rewards conversation. A well-timed reply under a large account's post will out-reach three of your own posts. Pick ten accounts in your niche, turn on notifications, and reply within twenty minutes of them publishing. Not with an emoji — with a specific opinion or a number.

## Video is no longer a bonus

Native video uploaded straight to X now gets far more distribution than a YouTube link. Sweet spot is 30 to 90 seconds, with burned-in captions, because most people scroll muted. A phone and one clear idea per clip is enough.

## Social proof decides the first impression

On X people open your profile before they follow you. An empty account with no followers gets a lower click-through rate even with identical content. A starter base of followers and engagement from [KupSledujici](https://kupsledujici.cz) is what a lot of profiles use so their first organic visitors take them seriously.

## Consistency beats perfection

Three posts a day for ninety days does more than one viral miracle. Plan a week of topics in advance and hold the pace even on days when nobody replies.

Start with the easiest lever: next week, reply to five large accounts every day and watch what it does to your profile visits.
